prompt_architecture.attention_weighting: Prefix camera direction and physical kinematics in the first 25 tokens. Avoid buzzwords like 'hyperrealistic', '4K', 'photorealistic' which dilute U-Net/DiT cross-attention.
rules: Always specify the camera movement type explicitly (e.g. 'Camera: Slow push-in, low angle').
Specify physical light sources with color temperature (e.g. '3200K tungsten bounce', 'diffused morning sunlight').
Action must use continuous progressive verbs ('running', 'grasping', 'turning head slowly').
Keep positive prompt between 40 and 80 words for optimal temporal stability.
